faq.q: Is a deposit required for a party?
faq.a: A non-refundable deposit is required to secure the party date. Please do not submit a deposit until you receive a confirmation email.

faq.q: Are you open in bad weather or the off season?
faq.a: During our slow season, we are weather and foot traffic permitted. Call us or check our Facebook page for real time updates.

faq.q: Is there a height limit for the Splash Zone?
faq.a: For the Splash Zone party, each child must be 42" tall to participate, no exceptions. For general Splash Zone tickets, you must be 5 years old and 36" tall. The Splash Zone is closed for the season and reopens next May.

faq.q: Who can ride the Supercharged go-karts?
faq.a: You must have a driver's license to participate. Single passenger only.

faq.q: Can a child ride with a parent?
faq.a: Yes. Child passengers age 3 and up can ride with a parent in a two-seater Power Up go-kart and in Spin Zone bumper cars.
We can accommodate field trips, church events, birthday parties, company team bonding, sports team parties, fundraising and more. Contact Brooke through the group events form.
